Compared with the initial protection period in 2002, the cumulative increase is more than 40 times.

Xinhua News Agency, Xining, Dec. 11 (Xu Xiaofei and Zhang Hongxiang)—The latest monitoring results show that the natural resources of naked carp in Lake Qinghai have increased by 0.71 million tons this year compared to last year, reaching a total of 10.85 million tons. Compared with the initial period of protection in 2002, the cumulative growth has exceeded forty times.

Xinhua Nyingchi, Dec 11 – (Xiao Fei Lu and Hong Xiang Zhang) According to the Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of Qinghai Province, latest monitoring results show that the biomass of barefin fish in Lake Qinghai has increased by 0.71 million tons this year, reaching 10.85 million tons, an increase of more than 40 times from when conservation efforts began in 2002.

Xinhua News Agency, Xining, Dec. 11 (Xu Xiaofei and Zhang Hongyang) — According to the agricultural and rural affairs bureau of Qinghai Province, latest monitoring results show that the stock of golden eye fish in Lake Qinghai has increased by 0.71万吨 this year compared with last year, reaching 10.85万吨. Compared with the initial phase of protection in 2002, the cumulative growth is more than 40 times.

XINHUA NEWS AGENCY XINGNING DE DECEMBER 11 –– (REPORTER LU Xiaofei AND ZHANG Hongxiang) FROM THE AGRICULTURE AND RURAL AFFAIRS DEPARTMENT OF QINGHAI PROVINCE: NEW MONITORING RESULTS SHOW THAT THE RESERVE QUANTITY OF BARE PILOSES IN TONGHE LAKE IN QINGHAI PROVINCE THIS YEAR IS 0.71 THOUSAND MEGATONNES HIGHER THAN LAST YEAR, REACHING 10.85 THOUSAND MEGATONNES. COMPARED WITH THE EARLY STAGE OF PROTECTION IN 2002, THE TOTAL GROWTH HAS ACCUMULATED TO ABOUT 40 TIMES.

cands.text: In the 1960s and 1970s, due to excessive hunting by humans and deteriorating spawning habitats for the barreleye fish, the population of Qinghai Lake barreleye fish declined sharply. By 2002, the estimated biomass of Qinghai Lake barreleye fish resources was only 2,592 tons.

In the 1960s and 1970s, due to massive overhunting and deteriorating breeding habitats for裸鲤 in Qinghai Lake, the population of Qinghai Lake裸鲤 sharply declined. By 2002, the estimated biomass of naked carp in Qinghai Lake was only 2,592 tons.

In the 1960s and 1970s, due to excessive hunting by humans and deteriorating environmental conditions for the breeding of scaleless carp in Qinghai Lake, the population of scaleless carp in Qinghai Lake sharply declined. By 2002, the estimated biomass of scaleless carp resources in Qinghai Lake was only 2,592 tons.

Between the 1960s and 1970s, due to large-scale hunting by humans, degradation of the habitat for bar-tailed grebes, and other factors, the number of Qinghai Lake bar-tailed grebe decreased sharply. By 2002, the resource蕴藏量of Qinghai Lake bar-tailed grebe had dwindled to only 2,592 tons.

Between the 1960s and 1970s, due to overhunting for human consumption and deteriorating spawning habitats of the barbel fish, the population of Qinghai Lake barbel plummeted. By 2002, the estimated biomass of Qinghai Lake barbel resources had dwindled to only 2,592 tons.

src: 为了保护三江源地区和青海湖水域生态环境、保护水生野生动物，维护青藏高原生物多样性，今年以来，青海先后发布长江、黄河、青海湖重点水域禁捕通告，构建起了“一江一河一湖”全面禁捕管理体系。

cands.text: To protect the ecological environment of the Three River Source region and Qinghai Lake waters, to protect aquatic wildlife, and to maintain biodiversity in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, since this year, Qinghai has successively issued notices banning fishing in key waters of the Yangtze River, Yellow River, and Qinghai Lake, establishing a comprehensive ban on fishing management system for “one river, one river, one lake.”

To protect the ecological environment of the Sanjiangyuan region and Qinghai Lake waters, to conserve aquatic wildlife, and to maintain biodiversity in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, since this year, Qinghai has successively issued notices banning fishing in key waters of the Yangtze River, Yellow River, and Qinghai Lake, establishing an all-encompassing ban on fishing management system for “one river, one river, one lake.”

To protect the ecological environment of the Sanjiangyuan region and the waters around Qinghai Lake, to safeguard aquatic wild animals, and to maintain biodiversity in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, since this year, Qinghai has successively issued announcements on the prohibition of fishing in key waters of the Yangtze River, Yellow River, and Qinghai Lake, establishing a comprehensive ban-on-fishing management system covering “one river, one river, one lake.”

To protect the ecological environment of the Sanjiangyuan region and the waters around Qinghai Lake, to protect water-based wildlife, and to maintain biodiversity in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, since this year, Qinghai has successively issued announcements for the prohibition of fishing in key waters of the Yangtze River, Yellow River, and Qinghai Lake, establishing a comprehensive ban on fishing management system for “one river, one river, one lake”.

To protect the ecosystems and aquatic wildlife in the Three River Source region and Qinghai Lake waters, and to safeguard biodiversity in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, since this year, Qinghai has successively issued notices banning fishing in key waters of the Yangtze River, Yellow River, and Qinghai Lake, establishing a comprehensive ban on fishing across “one river, one lake, and one river.”
